name: Electric and electrode steam boiler
description: Steam generator heated directly by electricity — resistance elements in a pressure vessel, or current conducted through the boiler water by electrodes at high voltage. No combustion, no flue gas and no fuel system, so it avoids the chimney, fuel infrastructure and air-permit scope entirely, and pairs with cheap or surplus site power; the electrification option for on-site steam.

subtypes.name: Resistance-element electric steam boiler
subtypes.description: immersion or external elements fed at LV/medium voltage, thyristor-modulated; Bosch ELSB and Cleaver-Brooks Model S are this type

subtypes.name: Electrode (direct current-through-water) boiler
subtypes.description: boiler water completes an electrical circuit between electrodes; used for utility-scale MW-class hot-water and steam output at high voltage

applications: emission-free process steam on sites with renewable or low-cost power
standby and peaking steam next to fired boilers
multivalent operation integrated into existing boiler systems
